item.title: Iya Valley and Oboke Gorge: Deep Mountain Wilds — Guide
item.description: The Iya Valley, deep in the mountains of western Tokushima, is one of the three most secluded valleys in Japan, a dramatic landscape of plunging gorges, forested peaks and mist, where the emerald-green Yoshino River has carved spectacular canyons over aeons. Its scenic heart is Oboke Gorge, where the river runs between sheer, sculpted rock walls of pale marbled stone. You can experience it in several ways: a sightseeing boat that glides through the calm depths of the gorge beneath the cliffs, or, upstream and down, thrilling whitewater rafting and kayaking through the rapids — one of Japan’s best whitewater runs.
